coverageSources.notes: All seven public Ontario listing pages reviewed. New records are independent directory leads; profile claims, employees and current licences are not independently verified. Non-staffing employment-support/immigration entries excluded.

gaps: Ontario's public licence register returned a connection error during this review; complete reconciliation and licence status remain unverified.
This directory is not an exhaustive census. Nonmembers, unpublished employees, branches, trading names and firms without accessible websites remain gaps.
A published specialty is not past hiring evidence. Attributed job advertisements are not proof of completed placements or open junior permanent jobs.
Public indexed LinkedIn activity is partial; full signed-in work and posting history could not be reviewed.
Internal HR, leadership and supplier account contacts may only be useful for referrals. Agency specialties are not inherited by their staff.
Contact details and agency status can change. No guessed emails are added. Outreach and responses are logged manually.

auditSummary.method: Person-attributed postings, explicit individual specialty fields, and self-reported recruitment history are distinguished. Agency services, employer sector, certifications and job-title keywords alone never justify personal domain tags.
